# Firecrawl Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that turns websites into clean data with Firecrawl: scrape a page to markdown, start an async crawl of a whole site, poll the crawl for results, map a site's URLs, and run web search. Firecrawl bills per page or request in credits — the skill confirms the URL and scope with you before scraping, crawling, mapping, or searching, and runs a map first when the bill matters. Uses a Firecrawl API key (fc-...), kept in Muse's secure vault. Free tier available. Draft: written from Firecrawl's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
